authorization: User: continue investigating training sufficiency and loss. Notified fixed2x2 with no data/network/physical expansion.
source: Original GRID100 train prefixes, GRID102 states/normalization/price, GRID103 gamma0 DQN checkpoints. GRID106 cases diagnostic only.

features.normalization: Training reachable states only, each date equal total weight; clipped standardized features in[-20,20].
features.station: Group locked to initial incumbent station, aliases respected. Learned policy does not change global search or station choice.

architecture: Exactly original SB3 QNetwork:41 ->64 ReLU ->64 ReLU ->2;6978 parameters, paired initial seed.

training.optimizer: Original SB3 Adam parameter groups, learning_rate0.0003, max_grad_norm10.
training.loss: Two prespecified loss functions in loss_definition.
training.targets: STOP=0, CONTINUE=(next best-admissible float32 reward gain - unchanged per-query fee*next_queries)/old gain_scale.
training.sampling: Equal date, equal starting prefix within date, uniform reachable position within prefix. Same initial task masses as DQN; replaces policy-dependent visitation/replay with complete paid-feedback coverage.
training.fitting: 3 exact Huber continuations and3 fresh MSE paths; both endpoints retained, original3 Huber short anchors reused.
training.intentionally_changed: Loss only in matched-budget pairs; number of updates only in same-loss pairs. All other inputs and sample streams fixed.

evaluation.primary: Four-date macro search net utility versus paired/all3 old gamma0 DQN and BATCH1; report all dates and seeds.
evaluation.secondary: Train/validation positive misses, negative continues, value RMSE, gain capture/query fraction, single/multi horizons and physical-call-balanced utility.
evaluation.critical: Postfit fixed3 contexts: original March108, original March552, RF-path March552. No added labels, fit weights, feature changes or rules from those cases.
evaluation.interpretation: Report paired loss/budget effects, all3 seed family means and per-date reversals versus fixedBATCH1. No selecting best configuration or convergence claim at cap.

limits: No larger network, new observations/scenarios, positive oversampling, fee/threshold tuning, final8 test access, DQN refits, physical closed-loop or automatic additional experiments.
experiment: 2losses x2 fixed update budgets. Huber7250 existing checkpoints reused.3 Huber continuations plus3 fresh MSE paths, all seeds retained.

loss_definition.HUBER: torch smooth_l1_loss beta1, mean over32x2 targets
loss_definition.MSE: torch mse_loss, mean over32x2 targets; unchanged optimizer and clip10

matching: Identical initial net, Adam, LR, targets, feature normalization, minibatch indices and scalar-label budget at each matched update. Huber resumes Adam and exact next minibatch from old7250.
budget_definition: 7250 and fixed4x29000 chosen before new evaluation based on still-decreasing prior TRAIN loss; no validation-selected duration.
interpretation: Paired loss effects at each budget, paired budget effects at each loss, all3 seed means/dates versus DQN and BATCH1. No claiming convergence at cap or selecting winning configuration.
